chapter: String bands, serenading and violin players
title: Louis Armstrong learned to read music only after leaving
summary: Asked about musicians who could not read, Dawson says Louis Armstrong came out of the home without reading and learned later, but was never a sight reader.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Yeah, but one man that I know that didn't get his learning, he got, he come up from the home, the generalist's home, but he didn't know the music, he know the notes, but I don't believe he knew much about Division.
Second side of real one, I just want to make sure. I see, yeah. You were talking about the guy who didn't know Division.
He got, he learned that when he went away. He learned how to read music after going away, but he wasn't no sight reader. He could spell a little, but not much.
